{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", sales.shape)
print("\nColumns:", sales.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\")
print(sales.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue dtype and look for QA orders
print("\nRevenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("\nUnique revenue values:", sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:\")
print(sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99')
print("\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())"}
